A1.justification: Both 13-page PDFs describe the same work and include three pages of supplementary material. Text, equations, figures and tables are readable and can be matched despite layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original VQAv2 and UCIT experiments, custom-sequence evaluations, ablations and sensitivity analyses in Tables 1–4 and Figures 3–5.

after.justification: v2 retains original numerical benchmark, ablation and sensitivity results for the proposed dynamic gradient guidance method in Tables 1–4 and Figures 3–5.

M1.justification: Gradient guidance, norm scaling, replay integration and Bernoulli sampling remain unchanged in Algorithm 1 and Eqs. 10–16. The correction to Eq. 8 aligns the stated optimum with the existing minimization procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ten VQAv2 tasks, six-component UCIT benchmark and VQAv2–VizWiz–TextVQA–Flickr30k sequence. The supplementary dataset examples are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Tables 1–2 retain CL-MoE, HiDE, SEFE, DISCO and MultiTask. The corresponding ablation comparisons also retain the same method variants.

E3.justification: Task orders, replay sizes, LoRA ranks, FAA metric, batch size, epochs and learning-rate schedule are unchanged. Section 4.3 replaces 'SGD' with 'GD' while retaining minibatch sampling; this does not establish a different optimization protocol.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same guidance/replay and buffer-size ablations, custom-sequence analysis, scaling/Bernoulli ablations and alpha sensitivity analysis. Supplementary distribution illustrations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Supplementary Section 2 newly states that each experiment is conducted over three trials. This discloses a previously unspecified run count; it does not establish an increase in runs. Existing plotted uncertainty displays are retained.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and Figures 3–5 retain their numerical results and trends. The proposed method's FAA remains 65.17% on VQAv2 and 73.82% on UCIT, with no added or removed result entries.

T1.justification: Eq. 8 changes arg max to arg min for the joint-task loss, correcting the mathematical definition of the optimal parameters. The remaining equations, assumptions and derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: approximating missing old-task gradients, combining guidance with replay, regulating updates through Bernoulli sampling and achieving strong performance without model expansion.

C2.justification: The interpretations connecting distribution shifts to weaker gradient approximation, greater replay dependence and alpha sensitivity are retained. Section 6 preserves the same limitations and future-work direction.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page footnote providing a DGG code-repository link, which v1 lacks. Other implementation details are retained; the newly disclosed trial count is assessed under E5.

R1.justification: The same 32 cited works and research positioning are retained. Several references, including SEFE, DISCO and ModalPrompt, receive publication-metadata updates rather than representing newly cited work.

P1.justification: v2 updates author affiliations and contact presentation, adds Section 7 Acknowledgments, revises bibliographic metadata and makes limited terminology edits. The scientific narrative and section sequence remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 compacts the author block and relocates existing displays, including Figure 2, Algorithm 1 and Tables 1 and 4. Figure 1's caption newly clarifies that arrows depict descent directions. The graphics and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the reversed optimization objective in Eq. 8, clarifies the figures' descent-direction convention, adds code-access information and discloses three trials per experiment. These provide limited improvements in mathematical clarity and reproducibility reporting while leaving the method and empirical evidence unchanged.
